question: Which of the following compounds is an Alicyclic compound?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclopropane**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cyclopropane** consists of** three carbon **atoms arranged in a triangular ring, with** each carbon bonded to two hydrogen atoms**.
 
• The bond angles in cyclopropane are approximately 60°, which is much smaller than the ideal tetrahedral angle of 109.5°.
 
• The carbon-carbon bonds in cyclopropane are **single bonds (σ-bonds),** but the strain causes them to be weaker and more reactive than typical single bonds in larger rings or chains.

 
• cyclopropane is more reactive compared to other hydrocarbons, and it readily undergoes reactions such as ring-opening and addition reactions.

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQcOjdYWghvMA7NsOGWewLdI_RHfIjKRx75j6ipKFSRL_PkW2KgTEhbEFb2eZDLhp8Jwgk&usqp=CAU] 

**Cyclopropane**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Isobutane:**

 
• **Isobutane**, also known as **2-methylpropane,** is a branched-chain alkane with the formula **C₄H₁₀**.
 
• Isobutane has a compact, branched structure where three carbon atoms form a chain, and the fourth carbon is attached as a branch.
 
• **Uses:** Refrigerant, fuel for portable stoves, propellant in aerosols.
 
• **Properties:** Colorless, odorless gas with a lower boiling point than n-butane.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db66a74c889d05912bd0a62c76a8f88ad79c52e73915c52bc3fe740891ae2927.png] 

**(Isobutane)**

**Acetic acid:**

 
• **Acetic acid **has the formula** CH₃COOH.**
 
• It consists of a** carboxyl group (**COOH) attached to a **methyl group** (CH₃).
 
• Acetic acid is widely used as a vinegar ingredient for culinary purposes, as well as in the production of chemicals like acetic anhydride and acetate esters.
 
• It's also used in the** textile industry** and as a solvent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98dd4fb471038b5eeb91f495658b13d3666018552d56edc0cb65cea00b62c4fe.png] 

**(Acetic acid)**

**Ethane:**

 
• Ethane has the formula **C₂H₆**. It consists of a two-carbon chain with each carbon atom bonded to three hydrogen atoms.
 
• Ethane is primarily used as a feedstock in the production of ethylene, which is a key raw material for manufacturing plastics and other chemicals.
 
• It is also used as a fuel and in refrigeration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f3ba5558ae686bca24f615c70e40e4099b32618728a14507283440c106a18a1.png] 

**(Ethane)**
